verses.eng: Yawachanan also came forward and said: "O Adanay, bid me also speak the solution of the words which your light-power has prophesied aforetime through Dawad."

And Jesus answered and said to Yawachanan: "To you too, Yawachanan, I give commandment to speak the solution of the words which my light-power has prophesied through Dawad: "'10. Grace and truth met together, and righteousness and peace kissed each other. "'11. Truth has sprouted forth out of the earth, and righteousness looked down from heaven.'"

Yawachanan further interprets the same scripture. And Yawachanan answered and said: "This is the word which you have said to us aforetime: 'I have come out of the Height and entered into Tzabaawath, the Good, and embraced the light-power in him.' Now, therefore, Grace and truth' which 'met together,'--you are grace,' you who art sent out of the regions of the Height through your Father, the First Mystery which looks within, in that he has sent you, that you may have mercy on the whole world. Truth' on the other hand is the power of

Tzabaawath, the Good, which bound itself in you and which you have cast forth to the Left,--you the First Mystery which looks without. And the little Tzabaawath, the Good, took it and cast it Of Tzabaawath, Barbelo, Yabraoth and the light-vesture. forth into the matter of Barbelo, and he made proclamation concerning the regions of Truth to all the regions of those of the Left. That matter of Barbelo then it is which is body for you to-day.

"And righteousness and peace' which 'kissed each righteousness' then are you who did bring all the mysteries through your Father, the First Mystery which looks within, and have baptized this power of Tzabaawath, the Good; and you did go to the region of the rulers and did give to them the mysteries of the Height; they became righteous and good.

Peace' on the other hand is the power of Tzabaawath, that is your soul, which did enter into the matter of Barbelo, and all the rulers of the six aeons of Yabraoth have made peace with the mystery of the Light.

"And truth' which 'sprouted forth out of the earth,'--it is the power of Tzabaawath, the Good, which came out of the region of the Right, which lies outside the Treasury of the Light, and which has come into the region of those of the Left; it has entered into the matter of Barbelo, and has made proclamation concerning the mysteries of the region of Truth.

Righteousness' on the other hand which looked down from heaven,' is you the First Mystery which looks down without, as you did come out of the spaces of the Height with the mysteries of the Light-kingdom; and you
did come down upon the light-vesture which you did receive from the hand of Barbelo, which [vesture] is Jesus, our Saviour, in that you did come down upon him as a dove."
It came to pass then, when Yawachanan had brought forward these words, that the First Mystery which looks without, said to -him: Well said, Yawachanan, beloved brother."

Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al are summoned to help Pistis Sophia. The First Mystery again continued and said: "It came to pass, therefore, that the power which had come out of the Height, that is I, in that my Father sent me to save Pistis Sophia out of the chaos, [that] I, therefore, and also the power which did go from me, and the soul which I had received from Tzabaawath, the Good,--they drew towards one another and become a single light-stream, which shone very exceedingly. I called down Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al out of the aeons, at the command of my Father, the First Mystery which looks within, and I gave to them the light-stream and let them go down into the chaos to help Pistis Sophia and to take the light-powers, which the emanations of Self-willed had taken from her, from them and give them to Pistis Sophia.
in the dark chaos; nor could they lay hold of it with the art of Self-willed, who rules over the emanations.

The light-stream restores the light-powers to Sophia. "And Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al led the light-stream over the body of the matter of Pistis Sophia and poured into her all the light-powers which they had taken from her. And the body of her matter became shining throughout, and all the powers also in her, whose light they had taken away, took light and ceased to lack their light, for they got their light which had been taken from them, because the light was given them through me. And Mayak-Al and Gabaray-Al, who ministered and had brought the light-stream into the chaos, will give them the mysteries of the Light; it is they to whom the light-stream was entrusted, which I have given to them and brought into the chaos. And Mayak-Al and Gabaray-Al have taken no light for themselves from the lights of Sophia, which they had taken from the emanations of Self-willed.
When then the First Mystery said this to the disciples, that it had befallen Pistis Sophia in the chaos, he answered and said to them: Understand you in what manner I discourse with you?"
Kayapaa came forward and said: "My Adanay, concerning the solution of the words which you have spoken, thus has your light-power prophesied aforetime through Shalamah in his Odes:

Kayapaa interprets the narrative from the Odes of Shalamah. "'1. A stream came forth and became a great wide flood. "'2. It tore away all to itself and turned itself against the temple. "'3. Dams and buildings could not hold it, nor could the art of them who hold the waters. "'4. It was led over the whole land and laid hold of all. "'5. They who were on the dry sand, drank; their thirst was quieted and quenched, when the draught from the hand of the Highest was given. "'6. Blessed are the ministers of that draught, to whom the water of the Adanay is entrusted. "'7. They have refreshed parched lips; they whose power was taken away, have gotten joy of heart and they have laid hold of souls, having

poured in the breath, so that they should not die. "'8. They have raised up limbs which were fallen; they have given power to their openness and light to their eyes. "'9. For they all have known themselves in the Adanay and are saved through the water of Life eternal.'

"Hearken, therefore, my Adanay, that I may set forth the word in openness. As your power has prophesied through Shalamah: 'A stream came forth and became a great wide flood,'--this is: The light-stream has spread itself out in the chaos over all the regions of the emanations of Self-willed.

"And again the word your power has spoken: 'The dams and buildings could not hold it,'--that is: The emanations of Self-willed could not hold the light-stream within the walls of the darkness of the chaos.
"And the word which it has spoken: 'They who were in the dry sand, drank,'--that is:
All in Pistis Sophia whose light had before been taken away, got light.
"And the word which it has spoken: 'Their thirst was quieted and quenched,'--that is: Her powers ceased to lack the light, because their light, which had been taken from them, was given them [again].
"And again as your power has spoken: 'The draught through the Highest was given them,'--that is: The light was given to them through the light-stream, which came forth out of you, the First Mystery."

"And as your power has spoken: Blessed are the ministers of that draught,'--this is the word which you have spoken: 'Mayakaal and Gabaray-Al, who have ministered, have brought the light-stream into the chaos and also led it forth again. They will give them the mysteries of the Light of the Height, they to whom the light-stream is entrusted.'
"And again the word which it has spoken:

"And again the word which your power has spoken: 'They have raised up limbs which were fallen, or that they should not fall,'--that is: When they poured into her her lights, they raised up all her powers which were on the point of being dissolved.

"And again as your light-power has spoken: They have received again their light and have become as they were before '; and again the word which it has spoken: 'They have given light to their eyes,'--that is: They have received sense in the Light and known the light-stream, that it belongs to the Height.
"And again the word which it has spoken: 'They all have known themselves in the Adanay,'--that is: All the powers of Pistis Sophia have known one another through the light-stream.
"And again the word which it has spoken: 'They are saved through water of Life eternal,'--that is: They are saved through the whole light-stream.

"And again the word which it has spoken: 'The light-stream tore all to itself and drew it over the temple,'--that is: When the light-stream had taken all the light-powers of Pistis Sophia and had spoiled them from the emanations of Self-willed, it poured them into Pistis Sophia and turned itself about and went out of the chaos and came over you,--you who art the temple.
"This is the solution of all the words which
your light-power has spoken through the Ode of Shalamah."
It came to pass then, when the First Mystery had heard Kayapaa speak these words, that he said to him: Well said, blessed Kayapaa. This is the solution of the words which have been spoken."

The fashioning of the serpent-, basilisk- and dragon-powers. the form of a great serpent; another again changed itself also into the form of a headed basilisk; another again changed itself into the form of a dragon. And moreover the first power of Self-willed, the lion-faced, and all his other very numerous emanations, they came together and oppressed Pistis Sophia and led her again into the lower regions of the chaos and alarmed her again exceedingly. "'1. O Light, it is you who have helped me; let your light come over me.

Sophia again cries to the Light. "'2. For you are my protector, and I come hence to you, O Light, having faith in you, O Light. "'3. For you are my saviour from the emanations of Self-willed and of Adamas, the Tyrant, and you shall save me from all his violent threats.'

Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al and the light-stream again go to her aid. "And when Pistis Sophia had said this, then at the commandment of my Father, the First Mystery which looks within, I sent again Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al and the great light-stream, that they should help Pistis Sophia. And I gave commandment to Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al to bear Pistis Sophia in their hands, so that her feet should not touch the darkness below; and I gave them commandment moreover to guide her in the regions of the chaos, out of which she was to be led.

"It came to pass then, when the angels had come down into the chaos, they and the light-stream, and moreover [when] all the emanations of Self-willed and the emanations of Adamas had seen the light-stream, how it shone very exceedingly and there was no measure for the light about it, that they became terror-stricken and quitted Pistis Sophia. And the great light-stream surrounded Pistis Sophia on all sides of her, on her left and on her right and on all her sides, and it became an light-wreath round her head.

chaos, nor was she any more in fear of the other new power of Self-willed which he had cast down into the chaos as an flying arrow, nor did she any more tremble at the demon power of Adamas which had come out of the aeons.

being on the right of Gabaray-Al and Mayak-Al. And the great light-stream entered again into her. And Pistis Sophia beheld with her eyes her foes, that I had taken their light-power from them. And I led Pistis Sophia forth from the chaos, she treading under foot the serpent-faced emanation of Self-willed, and moreover treading under foot the seven-faced-basilisk emanation, and treading under foot the lion- and dragon-faced power. I made Pistis Sophia continue to stand upon the headed-basilisk emanation of Self-willed; and it was more mighty than them all in its evil doings. And I, the First Mystery, stood by it and took all the powers in it, and made to perish its whole matter, so that no seed should arise from it from now on." Next: Chapter 67
And when the First Mystery said this to his disciples, he answered and said: Understand you in what manner I discourse with you?"
